product_one_liner.value: Luciq is an AI-powered mobile observability platform that helps mobile engineering teams detect, prioritize, diagnose, and resolve issues in iOS and Android apps.

named_customers.notes: Both are named in customer case studies.

employee_band.notes: Y Combinator lists a team size of 250.

hq_location.notes: The DPA gives its principal place of business as 230 California Street, San Francisco.

eng_blog.notes: Two posts by Hesham Abd-Elmegid describe the company's own SDK development and CI infrastructure using CircleCI and Buildkite/Anka.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes product guides, SDK setup, MCP, CLI, and API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current openings are Enterprise Account Executive and Product Engineer (Backend); neither has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The subprocessor list names OpenAI, LLC for AI-powered product features; it does not specify a model version.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022 certification, and GDPR compliance; GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced May 17, 2022, led by Insight Partners. Amount is as publicly announced.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is the May 2022 Series B, outside the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Enterprise Account Executive opening has an active application control.

launched_6mo.notes: The August 5, 2026 changelog announced the beta launch of Luciq Agent, an in-dashboard conversational AI assistant.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On August 11, 2026, Azul announced Kenny Johnston as its CPO and identified his most recent role as Luciq's chief product and technology officer. His exact Luciq departure date was not stated.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Public documentation lists Salesforce.com and Totango for customer relationship management, Hubspot for marketing automation, and MailChimp for mail services.
